senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) the planet Venus, morning star, evening star.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Ib.</cite> <he>היו בנו ירושלם עובדים לכ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>לכוכבים</he>) the Jerusalemites worshipped Venus openly &c.
